for: COMBAT FOUR's Sphere (slices/fight_ground/sphere/sphere.json, BUILD 11/20k): the names its handoff asked for, the garage's format. floor.floor is the bowl's floor (rows 0 to 2: sealed concrete gone dark, the last show's spike tape in yellow and white, forklift scuffs, glass from the panels in drifts on half the tiles; nothing within 1.2 m of an edge but the floor); floor.torn the floor broken where the rigging came down (row 3: plates round a hole to the fill under the slab, its dust thrown out, a margin of whole floor so it meets the floor); floor.high the tiers' step (row 4); floor.ring the bowl's floor. Any tile of a list meets any tile of it.

sp_screen.name: A SECTION OF THE SCREEN, DOWN

how_it_lays.the stage: sp_stage on every stage tile, a tile wide and deep, 1.3 m, foot its south edge middle (your 'at' [0.5, 1.0]); its deck units are the same at every edge, so the tiles meet into one stage.
how_it_lays.the screen: sp_screen a section 12.6 m long lying west to east and 3 m south over the tile, its middle 5 m north of the foot (your 'at' [0.5, 0.92] puts it across the tile's middle), so a P beside a p reads as one section down; sp_panels the stack and its leaning panels, foot its south edge middle; sp_speaker the array on its side, 5.2 m, facing south.
how_it_lays.the floor things: sp_desk the riser, the console and the pen, 6.4 m; sp_cases a stack about 3 m wide, sp_cases_b two and a lid; sp_barricade a tile wide (twelve sections), the crowd's plates to the north; sp_camp_a / _b (sp_bedding_a / _b the same pictures): foot each at its south edge middle.
how_it_lays.the tiers: sp_tier on every high tile, 1.42 m up, foot its south edge middle, its treads the same at both edges; sp_seats on it (your 'at' [0.5, 0.82], lifted): eleven rows of 21 seats facing south, 9.4 m deep, a tile wide; sp_stair_e / _w the hall's concrete stair; sp_rail_ew the glass rail along a tier's front, sp_rail_ns along its side.
how_it_lays.the bowl: sp_wall_ew / _ns THE SCREEN'S FOOT: the concrete plinth to 0.7 m and the screen's lowest panels on their frame to 2.4 m; a tile long.

ceiling.what: the screen from inside, dark: its panels in rows round its crown, curving over from the stage; panels out and the frame and the speakers' grilles behind them; a long tear where a section came down, the frame's members across it and one panel hanging in it by its cable; nothing lit: one picture the size of the board
ceiling.contract: sphere.json 'ceiling' (COMBAT FOUR's: the fight draws it over the board at that alpha, rule 451(a)); 'tile' [20, 15] is the board: ONE picture, never repeated (the screen's rows ring its crown)
